title: Making a Game Engine
author: whensocksplay
selftext:
[Video Showing off the Engine](https://youtu.be/cbmD655nh8M)

Nothing is at all finished, this is just a first of many. I do plan on making everything open source of course, so people can have their own ai agents use or copy whatever. Youtube description says more, but I believe we're gonna live in an age where video games are a file type, same as .png, .obj, or .blend. That we can manipulate any game, and basically do whatever we want with them. Utilizing their assets, remixing them, etc. 

That's one of the foundations this engine will be built on, hopefully a release soon!
